notes.title: Update 1.0.5.0
notes.content:
[h1][b]Update.[/b][/h1]
The release pointed out some errors in the game, it needs to be polished. This update fixes mechanics, level construction and some little bugs. 

[h1][b]Barbed wire:[/b][/h1]
You can get out of it. If you got trapped, move slowly, don't flounce or you will die. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34152060/94cce7bfa8d4593b3f8bce9d067de0e118cfb150.gif[/img]

[h1][b]Jumping from the walls:[/b][/h1]
The soldier slows down the speed of falling by touching the walls. That increases the reaction time and makes the jumps easier. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34152060/15cf05b84ff50d6b661c1f44cec426ebd0d1a8dd.gif[/img]

[h1][b]Controls:[/b][/h1]
Now it is possible to customize the keyboard controls as an option.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34152060/8c26c397c1747d2e95044ac440135420093c693c.gif[/img]

[h1][b]Minefields:[/b][/h1]
There are no “mines” in the game, but there are “minefields”, with dangerous and safe areas. The safe areas you can move through are better to recognize now.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34152060/f8822816925e5f543b850d43fdc80b8d04f4d8f7.gif[/img]

[h1][b]Difficulty:[/b][/h1]
We added a difficulty settings menu, where you can enable or disable checkpoints, barbed wire visibility and marking of enemies when they appear.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34152060/0276a969bb6bf6eef1f50f0f7ca90cac11029202.gif[/img]

[h1][b]Warning: [/b][/h1]
Collected dog tags are not saved on checkpoints. You must disable the checkpoints to collect all of them.

[h1][b]Other fixes:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed errors in the text. 
[*] Fixed a bug when the soldier died at the start (missions 5 and 7). 
[*] Fixed a screenshot bug on F12.
[*] Improved the shooting from the tank at the level "IRON FIST". 
[*] Fixed bugs at the level "STEEL FRONTIER”. 
[/list]
